project.name: Mastercard GFF 2026 AI Defense Lab
project.mission: Identify, generate, defend against, and learn from emerging synthetic payment-fraud scenarios in a governed closed loop.

workflow.purpose: Review attack intelligence and propose bounded scenario metadata.
Human-approve a scenario before generating reproducible fictional transactions.
Run XGBoost inference, graph signals, and policy decisions in the isolated simulator.
Inspect dataset lineage, model errors, and excluded-family generalization.
Queue false positives and false negatives for human review without automatic promotion.

action_endpoints.effect: Create a review-gated synthetic scenario draft
Record a simulated outcome and create review candidates when appropriate

agent_instructions: Treat measured metrics as synthetic-benchmark evidence, not production performance.
Never imply that public benchmark references were ingested unless an artifact proves it.
Never generate operational fraud instructions, access live payments, or bypass human review.
Prefer read endpoints for grounding before invoking an action endpoint.
Preserve model, scenario, feature, and dataset version identifiers in explanations.
